skill_defects: references/method.md 'Step 3 — Apply tolerances' lists price, quantity and total tolerances but never says how they combine. PO-1040 is inside the price tolerance (1.80% < 2%) and 1,566.20 over the total tolerance (25); the skill gives no rule for whether that is 'within tolerance → auto-match' or an exception.

references/method.md 'Step 4' table: exceptions 3 ('Quantity overbilling') and 4 ('Short-shipment billed in full') have the identical description 'Invoice qty > GRN qty' — indistinguishable; 90-of-100 could be raised as either or both.

references/method.md 'Step 1' says invoices entered as a single line 'limit the match to header level' but gives no procedure for a header-only bill against a one-line PO (infer unit price from total? raise exception 1 or only a total variance?).

SKILL.md Stage 1 and method.md say nothing about bills with no PO reference (7 of 12 here). Exception 5 is 'invoice line has no matching PO line'; whether a wholly non-PO bill is exception 5, out of scope, or a separate status is undefined.

references/edge-cases.md 'Goods received before the PO was issued' tests receipt date against PO date; the method's PO field list has both 'PO date' and 'approval timestamp' but no rule for receipt-before-approval when only the approval date exists.

references/method.md 'Step 4' exception 9 is 'paid already' (prior invoice); a duplicate between two open bills is only covered by pointing to another skill ('see duplicate-invoice-detection'), so severity/handling inside this skill is unclear.

SKILL.md 'Upload path' checklist marks tolerance policy and approval matrix 'Type it in the chat', and references/method.md 'Inputs' calls the matrix Optional while SKILL.md says Recommended — inconsistent, and no guidance on validating an uploaded policy document.
references/output.md Sections A–B (workspace name, capability map from get_datasource_tools, fixture flag) have no upload-path wording.

open_bills has no line detail (qty, unit price, tax), so 'billed price' and '100 cartons billed' in the key are inferred from totals, not in the data; manifest calls purchase_orders.csv 'with lines' but there is one line per PO and no PO date/currency.
